items.title: Sheila Jordan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And uh, the drummer's name was Sir John. ... I did an extra couple of nights just with the, the drums and the piano

ctx.x: Oh, I know what we were talking about. Then I moved over to Ninth Avenue and 26th Street, and I got a job at this club called the Page Three, which is on Seventh Avenue. And uh, they had Monday night sessions there, and then Tuesday was just a, a duo. A piano and drums. Why not, why not piano and bass, I‟ll never know, but they didn‟t. And uh, the drummer‟s name was Sir John. And the piano player was sometimes it was Baldo Williams, and then there was another German guy that played there. And then there was a guy…
